settings.label: Starting chips
settings.help: Chips a new player's wallet starts with.

settings.label: Daily bonus
settings.help: Chips awarded each time a player claims the daily bonus.

settings.label: Daily bonus cooldown (hours)
settings.help: How long a player must wait before claiming the daily bonus again.

settings.label: Table entry fee rate
settings.help: Fraction of the buy-in taken as an entry fee when a player sits down. 0.02 is 2%.

settings.label: Activity reward
settings.help: Chips awarded for lobby activity, such as playing a hand.

settings.label: Win reward
settings.help: Chips awarded on top of the pot for winning a hand.
